decision.text: Priya emails the three partners who asked for the delivery window; Daniel updates the API spec and the changelog by Friday.

changedDecision.before: Ship version 3 of the API, with a delivery window object replacing the ETA field, by November 18.
changedDecision.after: No version 3. The response stays backward-compatible: ETA is unchanged, and delivery window is a new optional field that is left out when unknown. Ship on version 2 by November 11.

openQuestion.text: Whether to backfill delivery windows for orders created before the change (about two million open orders). Maya will ask Priya; nothing was decided.

ask.question: Is the delivery window field required in the Orders API response?
answerPoints: No: the delivery window is a new optional field.
It is left out when the window is unknown.
ETA stays unchanged; the response stays backward-compatible on version 2.
This replaced the earlier plan to ship version 3 with the delivery window replacing ETA.

codingAgent.finds: The Orders API response must stay backward-compatible: keep ETA as it is and add delivery_window as an optional field, omitted when unknown.
